reason: As a remote hire deciding whether to stay, A tells me what I actually need to know: the $150 commuting support, that desks will be ready, that there are no other exceptions, the notice period, and exactly when and to whom to bring questions, with a named partner signing it. B leaves out the practical details and ends with unfilled "[Partner name]" placeholders, which undercuts its otherwise good "we're part of the problem" admission.
